companies.name: Murf.ai
companies.description: Murf.ai is an AI voice infrastructure company that provides text-to-speech, voice cloning, AI dubbing, and conversational AI voice technology for enterprises. The platform serves over 10 million developers and creators, powering voice agents, voiceover production, and multilingual content localization for 300+ Forbes 2000 companies across industries including healthcare, insurance, retail, and financial services.

companies.name: Netradyne
companies.description: Netradyne is an AI and edge computing company specializing in fleet safety and management. Its platform uses always-on computer vision and on-device AI processing across multi-camera systems to analyze 100% of driving time, providing real-time coaching, automated safety alerts, and natural-language video search for commercial fleets.

companies.name: SatSure
companies.description: SatSure is a deep-tech Earth intelligence company that combines satellite Earth observation, machine learning, and advanced analytics to deliver decision intelligence across agriculture, aviation, banking, forestry, insurance, and utilities. The company builds AI-powered platforms that transform raw satellite and geospatial data into industry-specific insights for risk assessment, credit scoring, and infrastructure monitoring.

agents.tagline: An autonomous AI calling agent that delivers 24/7 inbound and outbound voice support with human-like speech, handling up to 15,000 calls per day per agent.
agents.description: Murf AI Voice Agent is an enterprise-grade autonomous calling platform that deploys human-like voice agents powered by ultra-natural text-to-speech and real-time intelligence. The platform achieves sub-900ms response latency and 99.38% pronunciation accuracy across 150+ voices in 35+ languages, with mid-call language switching and conversational prosody that makes 8 of 10 listeners prefer Murf voices over competitors in blind testing. It supports the full call lifecycle including voicemail detection, warm handover to human agents, CRM integration for appointment booking, and script A/B testing for workflow optimization. The system handles up to 10,000 concurrent calls with built-in compliance features including consent management, DNC scrubbing, and enterprise-grade security certifications (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR).

agents.tagline: An ultra-low-latency text-to-speech API that powers real-time voice agents with 55ms model inference and support for 35+ languages at $0.01 per minute.
agents.description: Murf Falcon is a production-grade TTS API built on a compute-efficient proprietary neural architecture designed specifically for real-time conversational AI, IVR systems, and voice agent applications. It delivers 55ms model inference latency and sub-130ms end-to-end time-to-first-audio, making it one of the fastest production TTS APIs available, with data residency across 11 geographic regions for enterprise compliance requirements. The API supports 150+ professional voices across 35+ languages with MultiNative technology that enables seamless code-switching within single sentences, and offers programmatic control over pitch, speed, prosody, and 15+ expressive styles through its Speech Gen 2 engine. Falcon handles up to 10,000 concurrent calls and is backed by SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 (AI management), HIPAA, and GDPR certifications.

agents.tagline: An AI-powered voiceover studio that generates enterprise-grade synthetic speech with 200+ voices, full creative control, and team collaboration in 35+ languages.
agents.description: Murf Studio is an AI voiceover generation platform that enables enterprises to create professional-quality synthetic speech content at scale without recording studios or voice talent. The platform offers over 200 realistic voices across 35+ languages and 10+ accents, with granular controls including pitch, speed, intonation adjustment, word-level emphasis, and a shared pronunciation library for standardizing custom terms across teams. It features MultiNative voice technology that allows a single voice to speak naturally across multiple languages, voice cloning for creating near-perfect digital twins of authorized speakers with intellectual property protections, and simultaneous multi-user project editing for enterprise workflows. The platform integrates natively with creative and productivity tools and delivers content as embeddable audio for websites, presentations, and learning platforms.

agents.tagline: AI-powered fleet camera platform that analyzes 100% of driving time with edge intelligence for real-time safety coaching and fleet operations management.
agents.description: Driver-i is Netradyne's flagship AI fleet safety platform combining always-on computer vision with edge processing across up to eight cameras to monitor and analyze every second of driving time. The system detects over 30 types of risky and positive driving behaviors — including distracted driving, tailgating, lane departure, speeding, and seatbelt violations — with up to 99% AI accuracy, delivering automated in-cab audio coaching alerts in real time without cloud dependency. Its proprietary GreenZone Score quantifies driver performance by evaluating both safe and risky behaviors, enabling recognition-based safety culture through the DriverStars positive reinforcement system. The platform encompasses multiple hardware configurations and consolidates video safety, GPS tracking, maintenance diagnostics, fuel analysis, ELD compliance, and geofencing into a single integrated system through its Driver-i One offering.

fuel economy optimization and vehicle health monitoring across distributed fleets

expected_outcomes: Drivers with GreenZone Scores of 950+ are 2x less likely to have a collision

agents.tagline: Natural language video search powered by on-device edge AI that enables fleet managers to instantly find relevant footage across every vehicle.
agents.description: Video LiveSearch is a natural-language search tool that enables fleet safety and operations teams to query road-facing camera footage across their entire vehicle fleet using plain-text prompts such as "red car," "emergency vehicle," or "arrivals at a gas station." The system creates searchable video metadata directly on each vehicle using Netradyne's edge intelligence, making virtually 100% of road-facing drive time instantly searchable without waiting for cloud downloads. Its context-aware AI learns patterns in real-world road scenes and driving behavior, matching free-text searches to the most relevant clips and returning top results in seconds with before-during-after video context. Video LiveSearch operates across single vehicles or entire fleets, representing Netradyne's Physical AI vision where multimodal data on the vehicle is continuously interpreted.

agents.tagline: AI-powered agri-lending intelligence platform for climate-smart credit decisions.
agents.description: SatSure Sage is a full-stack decision intelligence platform that fuses satellite Earth observation data with financial and contextual intelligence to support the agricultural credit lifecycle. The platform uses machine learning for autonomous crop classification, acreage estimation, sowing/harvest forecasting, crop health monitoring, yield prediction, and climate impact analysis. It continuously monitors farm-level indicators across millions of plots and generates actionable risk scores, portfolio insights, and expansion recommendations for rural financial institutions. The system integrates with India's Unified Lending Interface (ULI) via an API-first architecture to deliver comprehensive credit profiles at scale.

agents.tagline: AI-powered aeronautical information management platform for airport and airspace intelligence.
agents.description: SatSure Skies is a multi-module aeronautical information management platform that digitizes and automates aeronautical data workflows for airports, air navigation service providers, and airlines. The platform uses high-resolution satellite imagery and machine learning algorithms for automated obstacle detection, terrain mapping, vegetation management, and change detection across airport environments. It generates ICAO-compliant electronic charts, digital airport twin models, automated eTOD surfaces, and real-time airspace use planning visualizations. The system operates semi-autonomously, continuously ingesting and validating aeronautical data through CRC32Q integrity algorithms.
